Our solution

Four steps. Low temperature. Metal by metal.

Sarix dissolves metals out of crushed e-waste and plates them back out selectively — no furnace.

Business model

We get paid twice on every tonne

🚚
1 · Gate fees

Businesses and councils pay us to take their e-waste and end-of-life panels. Landfill bans make disposal a legal obligation — collection is revenue, not cost.

🪙
2 · Metal sales

We sell the recovered copper, silver, gold and palladium at market prices. Mixed circuit boards hold roughly US$2,000–15,000 of metal per tonne.

💎
Later: rare-earth concentrate sales. Our process captures the critical minerals smelters destroy — a third revenue stream aligned with government critical-minerals strategies.
Uses the deck's range of US$2,000–15,000 of metal per tonne of mixed boards. Illustrative contained metal value — not Sarix revenue.
